data.narrative:
GHGSat is a Series D-stage space technology company that has raised $67M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies in Space & Aerospace: Sierra Space ($8.0B, Series C), Apex Space ($2.3B, Series D), Varda Space Industries ($1.6B, Series D), and Skyryse ($1.1B, Series C). A broader comp universe of five public Space & Aerospace names (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and eight additional private frontier-tech peers provides context but limited direct applicability.

The peer-median method is the primary applicable triangulation approach. The four same-sector comparables yield a median valuation of $1.9B, with a range spanning $1.1B to $8.0B. Stage-progression analysis was excluded because the implied valuation ($8.6B) exceeded 20x total capital raised, indicating an unreliable base. Public-comp anchoring could not be applied given the absence of revenue disclosure typical of private companies; the sector median P/S multiple is 27.4x across public peers, but lacks a revenue input for GHGSat.

The valuation analysis supports a range of $1.6B (low) to $2.2B (high), centered at $1.9B. This estimate rests on peer-median methodology across a limited sample of four companies. Key uncertainties include GHGSat's relative position within the peer set on revenue, growth rate, and capital efficiency—data not available in this file—and the sensitivity of the range to inclusion or exclusion of Sierra Space's $8.0B outlier valuation.
